architecture.teacher: Cached frozen DINO training targets only

joinRule: Positive gaps strictly below 3 seconds; overlaps and touching merge
ignoredRule: Subtract ignored intervals after padding/joining; never rejoin across ignored spans
metricAggregation: Pool intersections and durations across recordings before computing metrics
selectionRule: Strict 99% calibration only; maximum common-unseen exact-label F1_padP_coreR; highest-recall draw within the winning variant, breaking ties with F1_padP_coreR
whollyMissedDefinition: A nonignored saved-human rally core with no overlap with the padded, joined model export

allVideoEvaluation.interpretation: Exact, draft and export panels are separate; all and no-production-training scopes exclude beach. These panels include fitting/calibration recordings and are not an untouched generalization test. No-production-training excludes known production fitting exposure; production calibration exposure can remain.
